title: 2016 Pirate Year
about: Looking back on Pirate Year through the friendships, backstage moments, jokes, and small memories that defined it.
description: This track brings together the memories of Pirate Year: dorm-room laughter, performing onstage, Jason's perfectly silent scare, helping with the trapdoor effect, and the tiny background sea-monster gag. The pirate theme gave the year its setting, but the people and unplanned moments are what made it memorable. The music was chosen to reflect that year's pirate theme, giving the song the feel of a sea shanty and carrying a little of that world into the story itself. Years later, those friendships and stories are what continue to sail through my mind.
lyrics: Dorm room laughter late at night,
Learning more than songs to write.
Some memories never let you go.
One friend frozen without a sound,
One trapdoor hidden from the crowd,
One small ship turned back in fear,
The songs just gave it rhyme.
Some memories never let you go.
